brief: How to build an audience of 10K real fans in 90 days.

slots.title: PICK NICHE
slots.body: Stop trying to please everyone. Choose one specific problem you can solve better than anyone else and own it completely.
slots.author: Nora Cole

slots.title: CONTENT PILLARS
slots.body: Create three repeatable themes that prove your expertise. Consistency beats virality when you are still unknown.
slots.author: Nora Cole

slots.title: POST DAILY
slots.body: Show up every single day for ninety days. Visibility compounds when your audience knows exactly when to expect you.
slots.author: Nora Cole

slots.title: ENGAGE BACK
slots.body: Reply to every comment and DMs within the first hour. Conversations signal the algorithm to push your work further.
slots.author: Nora Cole

slots.title: GIVE VALUE
slots.body: Share actionable insights freely without holding back. Generosity builds trust faster than any growth hack ever will.
slots.author: Nora Cole

slots.title: COLLABORATE
slots.body: Partner with creators who share your audience. One introduction to their community can shortcut months of solo growth.
slots.author: Nora Cole

slots.headline: BUILD IT
slots.body: You already have everything you need. Open your notes and plan your first thirty days today.
slots.author: Nora Cole
